cause: The frozen human source labels contain hyphens. The pre-existing SourceBlob identifier domain only accepts [a-z][a-z0-9_]*. All original first-run cases stopped before lexical analysis with INVALID_WORD_SOURCE.
change: The evaluator maps every source label injectively to case_ followed by the UTF-8 hexadecimal of the original label, including both distinct identities in the replay-transplant case. The original material and first_run.json remain byte-exact.
validity: The 0/30 result of the original first_run.json is an invalid linguistic measurement caused by an evaluator precondition failure; it must not be described as zero Arabic capability.
